newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia cooperative KUB defers listing to 3-qtr.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia cooperative KUB defers listing to 3-qtr.

text.p: Malaysia's national cooperative for indigenous Malays, KUB Malaysia Bhd, said on Thursday it has deferred its listing on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) from the first quarter of 1997 to the third.

The later listing was due to a delay in converting the rights of land assets under KUB, now known as "Malay reserve land", to a subsidiary of the cooperative, KUB chairman Hassan Harun was quoted as saying by the official Bernama news agency.
Hassan said the Securities Commission had given KUB an additional six months to carry out the listing, proposed on the main board of the KLSE.

The stock exchange itself had not set a specific date, he said. "Maybe the exchange wants a very timely listing in order for shareholders to expect getting a maximum return on investment," Hassan told a news conference.
KUB has proposed to inject its entire assets worth 688.5 million ringgit ($277 million) into Permodalan Perak Bhd for the listing.
But Hassan has been saying that almost all the shares would be subscribed within the cooperative, which has more than a million members.
